migration.description: v1 is the only accepted schema version. A future v2 would declare a concrete, ordered set of field renames/removals and a migration tool before acceptance.

units.description: Combatant units described by symbolic identifiers only. No absolute source-game attributes, skill, level, perk, or moveset requirements are permitted.

actions.description: Action definitions. Each action is a timing and geometry commitment; no absolute damage or HP values. Stamina is a Skyrim-native resource tracked by the engine, never expressed as a fixed source-game constant.
